summary: BitcoinWorld reported that Monday.com blamed AI for 600 layoffs, while The Tech Buzz reported that the work-management platform joined a group of major tech companies explicitly citing artificial intelligence as a driver for workforce reductions.
evidenceQuote: Monday.com blames AI for 600 layoffs - joining a growing list of tech companies doing the same.
notes: Updated on 2026-07-26 to add the reported 600-worker layoff count from BitcoinWorld. Both sources frame the layoff as explicitly AI-cited.

sources.name: BitcoinWorld
sources.quote: Monday.com blames AI for 600 layoffs - joining a growing list of tech companies doing the same.

sources.name: The Tech Buzz
sources.quote: Work management platform becomes latest in growing wave of companies blaming automation for job cuts.
